title: AirQo Nexus
subtitle: Real-time air quality data platform
description: An interactive air quality platform providing real-time and historical air quality data across Africa. Access and visualize pollution data through an easy-to-use web interface powered by the AirQo monitoring network.
problem: Air quality data in Africa is sparse, fragmented, and difficult to access. Communities, researchers, and policymakers need a unified platform to visualize real-time and historical pollution data to make informed decisions about environmental health.
role: Contributed to the AirQo Nexus platform development, building data visualization components, real-time data pipelines, and the interactive map interface for exploring air quality monitoring stations across Africa.
approach: Built on the AirQo platform infrastructure with real-time data ingestion from Binos air quality monitors, interactive mapping with station overlays, historical data visualization with charts and trends, and responsive design for mobile field use.
hardestDecision: Handling the data quality challenges inherent in low-cost air quality sensors — building visualization that accurately represents sensor uncertainty without undermining user confidence in the data.
outcome: Live at nexus.airqo.net, providing real-time air quality data across African cities. Part of AirQo's suite of products serving communities, researchers, and policymakers.
whatIdChange: Would add predictive air quality forecasting using machine learning, implement community-contributed data sources, and add accessibility features for visually impaired users.
